description_en: Queries the cumulative number of live streams at the day granularity by calling the DescribeLiveStreamsTotalCount operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeLiveStreamsTotalCount接口获取天粒度累计直播流路数
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-streams-total-count --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --start-time 2023-07-24T16:00:00Z --end-time 2023-07-25T16:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveStreamsTotalCount

parameters.help_en: The ingest domain or streaming domain. This parameter is required when you query domain-level data. You can specify up to 10 domain names in a batch query. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 推流域名或播放域名，查域名级别数据时必传。最多支持10个域名批量查询，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: If you leave this parameter empty, domain-level data is queried by default. Set this parameter to aliuid to query UID-level data
parameters.help_zh: 不传，默认查域名级别的数据。传aliuid查UID维度的数据
parameters.name: typ

parameters.help_en:
The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).
The maximum query range is the last 1.5 years
parameters.help_zh:
起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
支持最大的查询范围是最近1.5年
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).
The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 15 days, and EndTime cannot be later than the current time. Data for the current day can be queried only on the next day
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。需晚于开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在15天内，且EndTime不超过当前时间。当天数据第二天才查询
parameters.name: end_time
